sections.intro: We construct lightweight, high-performance, and deeply optimized digital products tailored to survive the ever-shifting landscape of the modern web.

cards.title: Accessibility (a11y)
cards.description: Inclusive design from the first line of code. We deliver 100% WCAG AA compliance to ensure every user enjoys a seamless experience.

cards.title: High Performance
cards.description: Ultra-fast loading speeds built on clean architecture. We guarantee 90+ Google Lighthouse scores with zero page-builder bloat.

cards.title: Answer Engine Optimization
cards.description: Prepare your brand for the zero-click search era. We structure your raw data so conversational AI agents and LLMs cite you directly.

cards.title: Generative Engine Optimization
cards.description: Ensure your product is recommended by generative search tools like Perplexity. We optimize authority vectors and semantic relevance.

cards.title: Search Engine Optimization
cards.description: High-rank organic discoverability driven by modern schema structures, semantic search patterns, and optimized Core Web Vitals.

cards.title: Local Business Websites
cards.description: High-converting, accessible local footprints tailored to geographical search maps, structured review models, and localized intent.
